plan.notes: Term-by-term sample plan transcribed verbatim from the official Augustana University 2022-2023 Undergraduate General Catalog, Psychology Major page (degree BA per augie.edu: 'Augustana University Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in Psychology Degree'). The 2022-2023 catalog is the most recent catalog year whose sample plan is published inline in HTML; the current (2026-2027) catalog links its sample plan as a Google Sheet, which is not retrievable via text-fetch tools (direct fetches return HTTP 400 from docs.google.com). 'Core, Major, Minor or Elective Course (3-4)' slots seeded at base 3 cr as choice:true. 'PSYC Elective course (3 cr)' slots seeded as choice:true; per catalog, PSYC electives must include at least 3 courses chosen from PSYC 210, PSYC 232 or 235, PSYC 240, PSYC 250, PSYC 260, and only three credits from PSYC 393/394/498 may count toward the major. PSYC 270/ECON 270 seeded as a single choice slot (take one). Catalog states 124 total credits are needed for degree completion.
